reason: The flat toolbar is new in this change, so no earlier commit holds it. The browser test apps/web/src/features/paper/editor/chrome/paper-toolbar.browser.test.ts measures the live toolbar at 1440 and 390 and feeds the measurement to detect; the fixtures replay the old toolbar's failure of headings and lists hidden behind More at 1440. Caught by gate G1 (#2267). Introduced by 31312de3d (#2241): at 320 More and Align sat past the edge, at 200% text the style and font labels cut their text, and Escape from a menu sent focus to the page. The measure-based detect has no source file to replay, so the proof is the browser test run against 6e3809f93 with this change's tests: 4 of 9 fail there (More clips at 320px, Text style cuts its text at 390px, Escape from File moves focus to Paper page, print shows the toolbar) and 9 of 9 pass with the fix.
